newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Peregrine Manila unit hikes capital stock.
newsitem.headline: Peregrine Manila unit hikes capital stock.

text.p: Peregrine Capital Philippines, Inc, an affiliate of Hong Kong-based Peregrine Investments Holdings Ltd, said on Monday it would increase its capital to 570 million pesos from the present 380 million.

"The increase in capital is intended to bolster the company's plans to expand into fixed income securities origination and trading, private banking and asset management and derivatives," the company said in a statement.
The company gave a 50 percent stock dividend and a cash dividend of 15 pesos per share to its shareholders as of July 3.
The company's net income for the first half of the year reached 78.5 million pesos with total assets of 890.3 million pesos. No comparative figures were given.
